name: subprocessors
description: Draft this codebase's GDPR Art. 28 sub-processor list from its code: every vendor it sends data to (hosting, databases, payments, email, LLM APIs, monitoring, analytics, auth), with purpose, a personal-data guess, the region where the code says it, the DPA and the file and line it was found at; and check whether a change adds one. Runs npx --allow-git=root github:agentwares/subprocessors locally; no account, no requests, no LLM calls of its own. A draft to review, not legal advice.
